description.short: Built using Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder
description.full: SureBo? is a statistics proof-of-understanding agent that determines whether students truly own a concept rather than merely recognise an AI-generated answer. Grounded in verified NUS ST2334 materials and worked questions, it conducts adaptive oral-style assessments, detects precise misconceptions, changes its questioning strategy and produces an evidence-based Concept Passport showing what the student can explain, apply, distinguish and interpret rather than simply giving answers.
